text_blocks.snippet: Heart disease encompasses a range of conditions affecting the heart, with coronary artery disease (CAD) being the most common. CAD occurs when plaque buildup narrows the arteries, potentially leading to heart attacks. Other forms of heart disease include heart valve problems, irregular heart rhythms, and enlarged hearts. Symptoms and treatments vary depending on the specific type of heart disease.
snippet_highlighted_words: coronary artery disease (CAD) being the most common

list.title: Coronary Artery Disease (CAD):
list.snippet: The most prevalent form, where plaque buildup in the arteries restricts blood flow to the heart.

list.title: Heart Valve Disease:
list.snippet: Problems with the heart's valves, such as regurgitation, stenosis, or atresia, can disrupt blood flow.

list.title: Arrhythmia:
list.snippet: An irregular heartbeat, either too fast, too slow, or erratic, can affect the heart's ability to pump blood effectively.
